topic: Evernorth capital structure: issued Class A and Class C, SBI-affiliated Class C holders, Company Unit redemption rights, and contingent Class A supply
summary: Evernorth's October 30 prospectus reports 26,094,680 issued Class A shares as of October 22, 2026 and separately reports 31,392,746 issued and outstanding Class C shares as of the prospectus date.

The October 9 closing 8-K states that 2,359,038 Class C shares were issued to investors affiliated with SBI Holdings, Inc. because of the 39.9% ownership threshold. This is an Evernorth equity relationship, not evidence that those investors purchased XRP or control SBI's separate SBIC East Japan entity.

Class C shares carry economic rights but generally no voting rights, are not listed for trading, are transfer-restricted and are convertible into Class A under the prospectus's charter terms. Conversion changes class composition; it is not automatically new economic equity issuance.

The prospectus separately lists 22,953,128 Company Units that may be redeemed/exchanged for newly issued Class A shares one-for-one or, at Pubco's election, cash at the Class A VWAP. This is a potential share-issuance or cash-liquidity channel.

Other listed contingent or reserved Class A categories include warrants, convertible notes, incentive-plan shares, ESPP shares and the separate Cantor equity facility. They are not all issued, immediately exercisable or necessarily additive.

A simple sum of listed contingent Class A maxima is not a valid fully diluted count: it mixes conversion, redemption, exercise and reserved-share categories, some with alternative cash settlement and possible structural overlap. The artifact preserves each category separately.
None of these corporate-equity figures is XRP token supply, XRP escrow, XRP collateral or proof of actual XRP market purchases.

capital_structure.sbi_affiliate_pct_caveat: Derived only as 2,359,038 divided by 26,094,680 Class A plus 31,392,746 Class C. This is not total beneficial ownership, voting power or an ownership percentage of all Company Units.

contingent_or_reserved_class_a_categorie.category: Company Units held by holders other than Evernorth

capital_structure.gross_sum_caveat: Arithmetic sum only. Not a fully diluted share count or expected issuance: units may settle in cash; plan/ESPP reserves are not necessarily issued; warrants and notes are conditional; the ELOC is discretionary; overlap among legal instruments has not been fully reconciled.
capital_structure.issued_a_plus_c_caveat: Simple issued share-class sum only. Does not include Company Units, warrants, notes, reserves, other securities or any conversion/settlement mechanics.

sbi_relationship.relationship: Investors affiliated with SBI Holdings received 2,359,038 Pubco Class C shares at the October 9, 2026 closing.
sbi_relationship.stated_reason: Class C shares were issued to certain SBI-affiliated investors as a result of the 39.9% ownership threshold.
not_established: The filing does not establish that SBI Holdings itself is the direct registered holder of all 2,359,038 shares; it describes affiliated investors.
The Class C position does not establish XRP custody, XRP collateral, new XRP purchases or XRPL transaction flows.
This SBI Holdings relationship is not the same entity as SBIC East Japan discussed in the separate ChatGPT educational-event research.

claims.claim: Evernorth reports 26,094,680 Class A shares issued and outstanding as of October 22, 2026.
Evernorth reports 31,392,746 Class C shares issued and outstanding as of the prospectus date.
The October 9 closing 8-K says 2,359,038 Class C shares were issued to certain investors affiliated with SBI Holdings, Inc. because of the 39.9% ownership threshold.

Class C shares have economic rights but generally no voting rights, are not listed for trading and are subject to transfer restrictions; the prospectus describes conversion into Class A under the charter.

The prospectus lists 22,953,128 shares potentially issuable on redemption or exchange of Company Units held by holders other than Evernorth; the company may elect newly issued Class A one-for-one or cash at the Class A VWAP.

The prospectus lists 9,283,847 shares issuable upon warrant exercise and 3,585,278 shares initially issuable upon convertible-note conversion, with the latter based on maximum PIK interest and subject to adjustment.
The prospectus lists 8,930,929 Class A shares reserved for the Incentive Plan and 1,786,185 for the ESPP; these are reserves, not current issued shares.
The Cantor facility separately allows Evernorth, at its option and subject to conditions, to issue and sell up to 5,218,935 new Class A shares.
SBI-affiliated Class C shares equal approximately 4.10% of the simple issued Class A plus Class C share count. This is not a total beneficial ownership or voting-power measure.

The prospectus cover lists Class C conversion and Company Unit redemption/exchange categories separately; their complete overlap and settlement paths are not reconciled in this inventory. Do not add every category into one fully diluted count.

relationship_edges.to: New Class A shares or cash

hypotheses.statement: SBI-affiliated Class C holdings create a meaningful long-term economic alignment between SBI-affiliated investors and Evernorth's XRP-treasury strategy.
support: The closing 8-K confirms the Class C issuance to SBI-affiliated investors.
counterevidence_or_limits: The filing does not establish current beneficial ownership, voting control, XRP custody or future purchase obligations.

hypotheses.statement: Class C conversion could increase Class A tradable/voting float without creating the same amount of new economic equity.
support: Class C is already issued and has economic rights; the prospectus describes conversion to Class A.
counterevidence_or_limits: Conversion timing, holder elections and class-specific restrictions are not quantified.

hypotheses.statement: Company Unit redemption/exchange could create Class A issuance or cash outflow depending on Pubco's election.
support: The prospectus describes one-for-one Class A issuance or cash at VWAP.
counterevidence_or_limits: Actual redemption requests and Pubco settlement elections were not verified.

hypotheses.statement: The gross sum of all excluded/reserved shares represents expected dilution.
counterevidence_or_limits: The categories have different legal states; Class C is already issued, units may settle in cash, and warrants/notes/reserves/ELOC are conditional.

limitations: The exact current beneficial owners of all SBI-affiliated Class C shares were not independently reconciled.
The simple 4.10% SBI-affiliate ratio uses issued Class A plus Class C only and is not a complete ownership measure.
The relationship between Class C conversions and Company Unit redemptions/exchanges is not fully reconciled here.
Company Unit redemptions may settle in cash or newly issued Class A; actual elections and quantities were not verified.
Warrants, notes, plan reserves, ESPP reserves and the Cantor facility are not current issued shares.
No facility drawdown or incremental XRP acquisition was verified.
No directional XRP forecast is supported by this corporate-equity inventory.
next_actions: Reconcile the amended and restated charter and Company A&R LLCA to determine whether any Class C conversion and Company Unit redemption counts overlap.
Identify the exact SBI-affiliated registered/beneficial holders and any subsequent ownership filings without inferring from the issuer's affiliate label.
Monitor Class C conversion notices, Company Unit redemption/exchange notices, warrant exercises, note conversions and plan issuances.
Keep Evernorth equity issuance, treasury XRP custody, new XRP acquisitions and XRPL transfers as separate ledgers.
Revisit facility-funded XRP accumulation only after a confirmed Cantor drawdown, cash settlement and separate XRP purchase evidence.

forecast.reason: Capital-structure inventory is not synchronized XRP market data or proof of actual XRP buying.
